[quote=koranvistan;61402925]The doors opened in tandem, Elena on the other side. She stood with a few members of palace staff, Service workers ready to help with luggage.
She wore her olive trenchcoat, a black button down, and grey slacks. Her hair was secured in a braid, with little clips that had various green/yellow stones.
The doors closed behind the family as they entered, and Elena approached. [i]Your Excellency. Many thanks for your visit. How was travel? Could the staff help you with your belongings?"[/i]
She spoke with the typical 'stani stoicism and a cold demeanor. [i]"And a pleasure to see you once again, Kain. I hope alls been well?"[/i]
The Palace staff began moving about their duties, bringing luggage from place to place.[/quote]
The twin guards followed behind Kain and Abel, carrying the luggage of the royal family, and Joshua followed behind his parents as the group moved forward through the doors.

King Zachariasz nodded in acknowledgement of Elena. [i]"It was no issue, all went smoothly. Once again, I thank you for hosting us in your nation."[/i]

Kain smiled. [i]"All has gone well, no worries on our front. The Empire is in good hands at the moment during the absence of the royal family."[/i]

[quote=koranvistan;61412966]The Royal Family and their hosts were gathered in the drawing room. Susana was playing piano for the guests, Veronika and Kain were chatting quietly, and Elena was talking with the King.

Elena had been keeping an eye on the time for most of the evening. She knew the planes that were inbound to Velnaz that day, and it was too late for an arrival. Was she driving? She normally shows up around midday, she thought. Then she heard the knocking, and opened the door to see her there. The Queen's favorite soldier.

She grabbed her coat and stepped outside, grinning from ear to ear. [i]"My love, so good of you to drop by in the dead of night. You came from the air?"[/i] she pointed to the sky with a smirk, [i]"Like an angel of death,"[/i] she took a step closer and pointed, [i] or foreign spy! Who are you here for?"[/i][/quote]
As soon as she saw Elena, she rushed to her with a large hug. [i]"It feels like it's been so long since I last saw you!"[/i]

When she pulled away, she held her partner's hands in her own. Cecilia took on a grin of her own. [i]"I dropped from the skies. Special mission, they said. Pretty cool, right?"[/i]

[quote=stuipendia;61409306]The humming seemed quieter, but different here. More deliberate. As her robes flowed through the breezeless halls of the most high office, she would see a spartan grey paint job adorning the metallic walls. This was until she reached the turn to the left, and saw the office of [b][u]Him[/u][/b], the Overseer Superior, Li Jinping, in the flesh. Well, mostly flesh, his robotic arm was plain for all to see.  The floor was carpeted in red. In the back centre of the room, a Black Walnut desk sat in the surprisingly mostly empty room facing away from the large overlooking window, a modern computer sat on the edge of the desk, facing away from the Keeper. The room was large, though it could be considered devoid of any life and decoration, except that to her right was a large portrait of his wife, Ou Tangliang. To her left, a gigantic screen mounted the entire wall, though it remained inactive.[/quote]

Keeper Agnieszka bowed her head as she entered the room. [i]"Greetings to you, Overseer Superior,"[/i] she said. [i]"As you most likely already know, I am Keeper Agnieszka of Corzerran."[/i]

The Keeper took notice of the oddities in the room in her mind, remembering them to write down later in her book at another time. Her lies lingered on the portrait of Li Jinping's wife for a few seconds, and then they returned to scanning the room, then finally they rested on the Overseer himself.

Agnieszka was no stranger to mechanical enhancements that people would make for themselves, as she had seen this process completed not only in certain Church Chasseurs but also in the few members of the Ophanim Division, such as Director Tötentod, who she has had the opportunity to speak with before. However, she was curious still to learn the mechanism behind the action of the mechanical arm on the Overseer and to see how it different from the Corzerranean approach.

He looked up from his screen, taking a few moments to blink. Perhaps a sign of his growing screen time. In a moment, a smile grew across his face, and he rose, extending his human hand, he assumed it would be appropriate for the God-Worshipper to shake his human side. His appearance on any posters she saw along the way was remarkably similar, it was clear he did not attempt to hide his frailty. Though in his old age, he commands a nation of fifty million souls.

[b]"It is a pleasure to meet you, Keeper Agnieszka."[/b] The first sentence was in broken Corzerranean, he chuckled slightly. [b]"I did not have much time to brush up, this visit was a little sprung on me. I hope you understand."[/b]

He gestured towards the seat by her side, [b]"Please, sit. I am sure we have much to discuss."[/b]
